CREATE PROC [scorecard].[sp_AcademicPerformanceCharterSchools_MOD] AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Safe drop if table exists
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('scorecard.AcademicPerformanceCharterSchools', 'U') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE scorecard.AcademicPerformanceCharterSchools;
    END;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- CTAS with HEAP to avoid columnstore issues
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE [scorecard].[AcademicPerformanceCharterSchools]
    WITH
    (
        DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
        HEAP
    )
    AS
    WITH Cte_school AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT 
              [SchoolYear]
            , [StudentGroupType]
            , [StudentGroupCategory]
            , [StudentGroup]
            , [GradeLevel]
            , [TestAdministration]
            , [TestSubject]
            , SUM([CountMetStandard School]) AS [CountMetStandard School]
            , SUM([CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) School]) AS [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) School]
            , CAST(SUM([CountMetStandard School]) AS FLOAT) 
              / NULLIF(SUM([CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) School]),0) AS [PercentMet School]
        FROM [transform].[AcademicPerformanceSchool]
        WHERE [Charter School] = 'Yes'
        GROUP BY 
              [SchoolYear], [StudentGroupType], [StudentGroupCategory],
              [StudentGroup], [GradeLevel], [TestAdministration], [TestSubject]
    ),
    Cte_district AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT 
              [SchoolYear]
            , [StudentGroupType]
            , [StudentGroupCategory]
            , [StudentGroup]
            , [GradeLevel]
            , [TestAdministration]
            , [TestSubject]
            , SUM([CountMetStandard District]) AS [CountMetStandard District]
            , SUM([CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) District]) AS [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) District]
            , CAST(SUM([CountMetStandard District]) AS FLOAT) 
              / NULLIF(SUM([CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) District]),0) AS [PercentMet District] 
        FROM [scorecard].[AcademicPerformanceCharterDistrict] s
        WHERE [Charter District] = 'Yes'
        GROUP BY 
              [SchoolYear], [StudentGroupType], [StudentGroupCategory],
              [StudentGroup], [GradeLevel], [TestAdministration], [TestSubject]
    )
    SELECT 
          a.[SchoolYear]
        , a.[SchoolCode]
        , a.[SchoolName]
        , b.[DistrictCode]
        , b.[DistrictName]
        , a.[StudentGroupType]
        , a.[StudentGroupCategory]
        , a.[StudentGroup]
        , a.[GradeLevel]
        , a.[TestAdministration]
        , a.[TestSubject]
        , [CountMetStandard School]
        , [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) School]
        , [PercentMetSchool]
        , [CountMetStandard District]
        , [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) District]
        , [PercentMet District]
    FROM [transform].[AcademicPerformanceSchool] a
    JOIN [scorecard].[AcademicPerformanceCharterDistrict] b 
        ON  a.DistrictCode = b.DistrictCode 
        AND a.SchoolYear   = b.SchoolYear 
        AND a.StudentGroup = b.StudentGroup 
        AND a.GradeLevel   = b.GradeLevel 
        AND a.TestAdministration = b.TestAdministration
        AND a.TestSubject  = b.TestSubject
    WHERE [Charter School] = 'Yes'

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT 
          s.[SchoolYear]
        , '0000'   AS [SchoolCode]
        , 'Charter Sector' AS [SchoolName]
        , '00000'  AS [DistrictCode]
        , 'Charter Sector District' AS [DistrictName]
        , s.[StudentGroupType]
        , s.[StudentGroupCategory]
        , s.[StudentGroup]
        , s.[GradeLevel]
        , s.[TestAdministration]
        , s.[TestSubject]
        , [CountMetStandard School]
        , [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) School]
        , [PercentMet School]
        , [CountMetStandard District]
        , [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) District]
        , [PercentMet District]
    FROM Cte_school s
    JOIN Cte_district d 
        ON  s.SchoolYear       = d.SchoolYear
        AND s.StudentGroup     = d.StudentGroup 
        AND s.GradeLevel       = d.GradeLevel 
        AND s.TestAdministration = d.TestAdministration
        AND s.TestSubject      = d.TestSubject;
END

CREATE PROC [scorecard].[sp_AcademicPerformanceSector_MOD] AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Safe drop if table exists
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('scorecard.AcademicPerformanceSector', 'U') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE scorecard.AcademicPerformanceSector;
    END;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- CTAS with HEAP to avoid columnstore issues
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE scorecard.AcademicPerformanceSector
    WITH
    (
        DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
        HEAP
    )
    AS
    WITH cte_district AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT 
              [SchoolYear]
            , 'District' AS [OrganizationLevel]
            , [StudentGroupType]
            , [StudentGroupCategory]
            , [StudentGroup]
            , [GradeLevel]
            , [TestAdministration]
            , [TestSubject]
            , [CountMetStandard District]
            , [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) District]
            , [PercentMet District]
       FROM [scorecard].[AcademicPerformanceCharterSchools]
    ),
    cte_district_agg AS (
        SELECT  
              [SchoolYear]
            , [StudentGroupType]
            , [StudentGroupCategory]
            , [StudentGroup]
            , [GradeLevel]
            , [TestAdministration]
            , [TestSubject]
            , AVG([PercentMet District]) AS [PercentMetStandard District]
            , SUM([CountMetStandard District]) AS [CountMetStandard District]
            , SUM([CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) District]) AS [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) District]
            , CAST(SUM([CountMetStandard District]) AS FLOAT) /
               NULLIF(SUM([CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) District]),0) AS [PercentMet District]
        FROM cte_district
        GROUP BY 
              [SchoolYear], [StudentGroupType], [StudentGroupCategory], [StudentGroup],
              [GradeLevel], [TestAdministration], [TestSubject]
    ),
    cte_school AS (
        SELECT  
              [SchoolYear]
            , [StudentGroupType]
            , [StudentGroupCategory]
            , [StudentGroup]
            , [GradeLevel]
            , [TestAdministration]
            , [TestSubject]
            , AVG([PercentMetSchool]) AS [PercentMet School]
            , SUM([CountMetStandard School]) AS [CountMetStandard School]
            , SUM([CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) School]) AS [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) School]
            , CAST(SUM([CountMetStandard School]) AS FLOAT) 
              / NULLIF(SUM([CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) School]),0)  
              AS [PercentMetSchool]
        FROM [scorecard].[AcademicPerformanceCharterSchools] a
        WHERE a.[SchoolName] LIKE '%Sector%'
        GROUP BY 
              [SchoolYear], [StudentGroupType], [StudentGroupCategory], [StudentGroup],
              [GradeLevel], [TestAdministration], [TestSubject]
    )
    SELECT  
          a.[SchoolYear]
        , 'Charter Sector' AS [OrganizationLevel]
        , a.[StudentGroupType]
        , a.[StudentGroupCategory]
        , a.[StudentGroup]
        , a.[GradeLevel]
        , a.[TestAdministration]
        , a.[TestSubject]
        , [CountMetStandard School]
        , [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) School]
        , [PercentMetSchool]
        , [CountMetStandard District]
        , [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) District]
        , [PercentMet District]
        , [CountMetStandard State]
        , [CountofStudentsExpectedtoTest(including previously passed) State]
        , [PercentMetStandard State]
        , [PercentMet State]
    FROM cte_school a
    JOIN cte_district_agg b 
        ON  a.SchoolYear       = b.SchoolYear
        AND a.StudentGroup     = b.StudentGroup
        AND a.GradeLevel       = b.GradeLevel
        AND a.TestAdministration = b.TestAdministration
        AND a.TestSubject      = b.TestSubject
    JOIN [transform].[AcademicPerformanceState] s 
        ON  a.SchoolYear       = s.SchoolYear 
        AND a.StudentGroup     = s.StudentGroup
        AND a.GradeLevel       = s.GradeLevel
        AND a.TestAdministration = s.TestAdministration
        AND a.TestSubject      = s.TestSubject;
END
